note_gaps: Conceptual/opinion paper, no experiments: reports five prior verbal definitions of dexterity, a within-hand manipulation taxonomy (regrasping, in-grasp, finger gaiting, finger pivoting/tracking, rolling, sliding), an arm-vs-hand complexity trade-off (Fig. 1, Table I), and a qualitative review of prior hands (Utah/MIT, UB Hand, Gifu, DLR, Robonaut, Karlsruhe humanoid, Stanford-JPL, Karlsruhe dexterous, turntable manipulator). No quantitative dexterity metric (workspace/isotropy/manipulability) is worked out despite the bib why-field's claim.
